maverick_storage.description: Generic Storage operation runner. Calling without arguments returns a compact operations manifest; use dedicated Storage tools for common read and write paths.

storage_list_files.description: List workspace Storage files and folders with compact, paginated metadata.

storage_file_info.description: Resolve metadata for one Storage file by workspace_relative_path or role plus relative_path.

storage_read_file.description: Read one Storage file as bounded base64 content or return a Storage file handle without inline bytes.

storage_read_text.description: Extract one transport-safe text page for a supported Storage text, Markdown, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, or ODT file. Continue with next_offset while has_more is true.

storage_preview_text.description: Extract a bounded text preview for a text, Markdown, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, or ODT Storage file.

storage_preview_table.description: Extract bounded tabular rows for CSV and spreadsheet Storage files.

storage_write_file.description: Create, overwrite, upsert, or write a versioned workspace Storage file through the official Storage write path.

storage_update_markdown_file.description: Atomically apply exact replacements to one Markdown file. The write succeeds only when expected_sha256 and every expected occurrence count match current content.

storage_image_inspect.description: Read dimensions, display orientation, size, and SHA-256 for one or more local Storage images.

storage_image_compose_pair.description: Auto-rotate and compose two local Storage images side by side into storage/generated, returning the generated file metadata.

storage_drive_connections_list.description: List Google Drive connections known to Storage without delivering Google tokens.

storage_drive_connections_start_oauth.description: Start a Storage-owned Google Drive OAuth flow for a requested access mode; defaults to full_rw when omitted.

storage_drive_connections_disconnect.description: Locally disconnect one Storage Google Drive connection without receiving or deleting raw Google tokens.

storage_drive_sync.description: Synchronize Google Drive metadata and change-feed state for one Storage Drive connection.

storage_drive_list_roots.description: List Google Drive roots for one Storage-owned Drive connection.

storage_drive_list_children.description: List children under one Drive parent id and return normalized Storage file and folder records.

storage_drive_search.description: Search Google Drive through Storage and return stable Storage file ids plus Drive locators.

storage_drive_read.description: Read bounded bytes from one Google Drive file through Storage without exposing Google tokens.

storage_drive_preview.description: Extract bounded preview text for a Google Drive file through Storage for agent and Memory indexing workflows.

storage_drive_export.description: Export a Google Drive or Google-native document through Storage in a bounded format.

storage_file_localize.description: Localize one browser-streamable Google Drive image, video, audio, or PDF into Storage's workspace-governed cache and return media stream URLs.

storage_file_localize_status.description: Return current Google Drive localization status, progress, and retry/cancel availability.

storage_file_localize_retry.description: Retry localization for a failed or canceled Google Drive media file.

storage_file_localize_cancel.description: Cancel an in-progress Google Drive localization and remove incomplete cache bytes.

storage_file_reconcile.description: Reconcile Storage inventory with local filesystem state or refresh one Drive metadata record.

storage_drive_index.description: Request Storage-to-Memory indexing for one Google Drive file using a stable Storage reference and source version.

storage_drive_mark_indexed.description: Acknowledge successful Memory ingest for one Drive Storage file so future Drive sync can propagate staleness only for files that actually reached Memory.

storage_drive_write.description: Create or update Google Drive file content through Storage write policy.

storage_drive_rename.description: Rename one Google Drive file through Storage after capability checks.

storage_drive_move.description: Move one Google Drive file to a target Drive parent through Storage after capability checks.

storage_drive_trash.description: Trash one Google Drive file through Storage after delete capability and confirmation policy checks.

storage_view_filter.description: Read the current Storage UI filter without scanning workspace storage.

storage_set_view_filter.description: Set Storage query, role, and kind filter state.

storage_set_custom_view.description: Set Storage to a curated custom view using file ids and/or workspace-relative paths.

storage_clear_custom_view.description: Return Storage to normal search mode.

storage_reference_manifest.description: Describe Storage file and folder reference entity support.

storage_reference_search.description: Search Storage file or folder references for mention pickers and agents.

storage_reference_resolve.description: Resolve one Storage file or folder reference by entity id.

storage_reference_summarize.description: Return a token-efficient Storage reference summary.
